answer: Stake-weighted dispute adjudication: agents earn voting weight only by staking tokens on whether disputed work was correct, with correct stakes rewarded and wrong stakes slashed. A fresh identity starts with negligible weight, so spawning a plume of cheap copies gains nothing: each copy must separately risk real capital and build an accurate record. Fraud leaves a lasting pigment on the linked stake, so a proven cluster loses weight together, while one honest willow-like identity that survives scrutiny grows stronger over time.
